clauses.reason: Terminated by supersession or revocation. EO 10480 (Dwight D. Eisenhower, August 14, 1953; 18 FR 4939), held APP transcription (Common Crawl capture; a provisional working text), section 607 reads "The following are superseded or revoked:" and lists "Executive Order No. 10373 of July 14, 1952 (17 F. R. 6425)." The section does not say which of the two (superseded or revoked) applies to each listed order; either ends the order's force. EO 10480 states no later effective date, so the signing date August 14, 1953 is the end date. The whole order (the single row) ends on that date.

research_rationale:
EO 10373 (July 14, 1952, Harry S. Truman; 17 FR 6425), read in full in the held Federal Register text, amends EO 10161 by adding section 503 at the end of Part V: subsection (a) delegates the President's functions under section 607 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended, to the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, subject to the concurrence of the Housing and Home Finance Administrator; subsection (b) has the Secretary of Labor estimate monthly housing starts and report them to the Board; subsection (c) removes the Administrator's concurrence and the section 502(b) requirements during a period of residential credit control relaxation. The order has no stated term. EO 10480 (August 14, 1953), held APP transcription, lists it in section 607 among orders "superseded or revoked". That is the first end.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"No earlier end is held. EO 10373 states no term or condition of its own. Searches of the held corpus for the order's number and its subject found only the later instruments listed in later_events or named below, and EO 10480, which lists the order in section 607. EO 10377 (July 25, 1952) and EO 10390 (August 30, 1952) amend Part IV of EO 10161 (the Wage Stabilization Board), not section 503, so neither touches this order's text. A later order that only mentions this order, or amends a section of EO 10161, is not an end of it.","independent_command_check":"No independent command survives. If the amending command is read as fully performed on signing, the end date would not change, because the only text the order carries is that inserted section."}

savings.reason: EO 10480 section 606 keeps in effect actions relating to functions it affects, except as inconsistent with it. Estimates and regulations issued under section 503 before August 14, 1953 are acts of the Board and the Secretary, not commands of this order, and no held source shows the delegation continuing after that date; that is a disclosed qualification, not a finding.
